p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens up the official sources up to date, then you read them in your own language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): customs duties, taxes, rules and procedures per product and country on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market access map (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labels and health regulations that this country imposes on products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trading with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: Taric: Customs Code and import duties
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a business, taxes, international trade, by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that the regulator has not marked the platform as green before you trust it with your money
p.espaces.rg_note: To open the site in your language, use the translation function of your browser or the "Understand the document" function for a document.To make an important decision, ask an expert in your country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarder and driver.

p.espaces.cu_t1: Market access map (ITC, UN-WTO): obligations and rules for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs duties, taxes and rules of origin step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Shipping document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Land)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for companies importing or exporting within the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the export-cleared goods to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads on ship; after that, risk and cost are borne by buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays freight and insurance at port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: the seller delivers the goods to destination, the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Everywhere prohibited or controlled: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines.Such lists are rejected and can be notified.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, find out the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that is shipped directly to the customer by the supplier, easy to start, but you are still responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no regulated products without permission.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale/Supplier" lists here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before sale.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Find out the real price: product, delivery, customs, VAT in the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trading rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect your customers’ rights: clear prices including taxes, return policy, warranty and privacy.

p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
